Known methodological breaks

Source: R/pks_breaks.R
pks_breaks.Rd

Changes in the PKS that make values before and after a year incomparable or only partly comparable: new offence definitions, key changes, changes in the population denominator, boundary reforms and others. Check these before interpreting changes over time.

Usage

pks_breaks()

Value

A tibble with break_id, first_year, offence_key (keys separated by ;, empty when all keys are affected), variable, type, comparable (yes, likely, unknown, no), description, evidence and status.

Details

The table is a snapshot of known_breaks.csv of pksR-data that ships with the package; each data release contains its own copy.

Deutsch

Bekannte methodische Brüche der PKS: neue Definitionen, geänderte Schlüssel, geänderte Bezugsbevölkerung, Gebietsreformen und andere. comparable gibt an, ob Werte vor und nach dem Jahr vergleichbar sind (yes, likely, unknown, no). Vor jeder Zeitreihe prüfen.

See also

Other metadata: pks_offences()

Examples

b <- pks_breaks()
b[b$comparable == "no", c("first_year", "offence_key", "description")]
